title: In Iceland, how many Yule Lads come down from the mountains, one each night, in the run-up to Christmas?

In Iceland, how many Yule Lads come down from the mountains, one each night, in the run-up to Christmas?

The answer is further down ↓

·
·
·

Answer: Thirteen. The first arrives on 12 December. Their mother is the troll Grýla.

It's one of the 300 questions in our Christmas Quiz Book, in a UK and an American edition, on Amazon.
